window.note: run_state.window_end was ALREADY 2026-08-09 when this run started and latest_summary already pointed at an existing summaries/2026-08-09.json reporting 39 rows from two runs earlier the same day. The window was therefore zero-length. Rather than sweep nothing, this run re-covered the same 2026-07-26 to 2026-08-09 window and targeted the geographies the two earlier runs left thinnest, principally India.

anomalies: ZERO-LENGTH WINDOW: third run on the same date. Not a failure, but run_state cannot express intra-day runs and the summary filename collides; both were merged rather than overwritten.

SUMMARY FILENAME COLLISION: summaries/2026-08-09.json already existed. Merged forward (row_count 39 -> 49, key_points/notable_numbers/conflicts prepended, what_changed rewritten to cover all three runs). Nothing overwritten.
RUN LOG COLLISION: runs/2026-08-09.json already existed from the second run. Written as runs/2026-08-09-run3.json rather than truncating it. Deviates from the STEP 9 filename, deliberately.

CLAIM_KEY COLLISION IN SCHEMA: 4 of the 10 rows are unquantified and all reduce to 'IN|mixed_grains|kharif 2026|na|None|None'. Keying claims_index on that alone keeps only the last and silently loses three. Rows carry the schema-exact claim_key; the INDEX key is suffixed '#<id>' for unquantified rows only. NEEDS A HUMAN DECISION.

SERIES COLLISION AVOIDED: a draft row expressing the sowing gap as 2.9 per cent would have entered the same IN|india (national)|mixed_grains|planted_area|Down To Earth series as the 89.42 Mha reading, putting a percentage and a hectares figure in one series. Recorded unquantified instead (n002).
UNRESOLVED CONTRADICTION: n001 (89.42 Mha) vs a032 (78.738 Mha) vs j038 (78.7 Mha) for India end-July kharif area, all citing the same ministry series.

TWO STALE-SOURCE TRAPS AVOIDED: an AHDB 'winter barley and oilseed rape harvests now complete' page surfaced as current but the only fetchable text is a 2025 repost; an ADMIS cocoa note surfaced as current is dated 2026-06-01. Neither recorded.
UNFETCHABLE: ahdb.org.uk and fginsight.com both returned empty bodies to web_fetch (client-rendered). No AHDB figure was recorded from search-engine synthesis alone.
